correctness.rationale: The source gives the exact identity hat(chi)(u,eta)=alpha^{-(d-1)}F_{d-1}(u,|eta|/alpha). Therefore kappa is exactly the infimum of sqrt(u^2+alpha^2 s^2) over the alpha-independent zero set Z_d. Pointwise monotonicity proves the two monotonicity statements. The lower limit is rho_d because s>=rho_d; the upper limit follows from an arbitrary epsilon-minimizer of the s-coordinate and does not assume attainment. Positivity and finiteness of rho_d follow from the source zero-free strip and nonemptiness proposition. Substitution of the source equal-volume-ball formula gives the normalized exact limit. All quantifiers and boundary cases alpha>0, d>=3 are explicit, and no finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

The closest published comparison record strengthens the zero-free lower strip explicitly but still supplies a lower bound rather than the exact variational asymptotic. The new statement follows from an exact minimization representation over the fixed rescaled zero set and yields both monotonicity and the full limit with the sharp transverse threshold. No checked source states or implies that equality without the additional fixed-zero-set argument.

value.rationale: The source paper uses elongated bipyramids as its main higher-dimensional counterexample and records only a lower asymptotic bound. The exact leading coefficient is a natural invariant of that construction: the sharp transverse zero-free threshold of the rescaled profile. Identifying it turns qualitative/one-sided growth into a full asymptotic law, adds monotonicity, and isolates the precise remaining analytic task of evaluating rho_d. This is a structural sharpening of the main counterexample mechanism rather than an arbitrary numerical slice or routine recomputation.
